map.📚 玫瑰糠疹(母斑子斑)鉴别器: 📚 Pityriasis Rosea (Herald Plaque and Daughter Lesions) Differentiator
map.勾选临床特征，辅助鉴别玫瑰糠疹（母斑+子斑圣诞树样分布）与体癣、二期梅毒、点滴状: Check clinical features to help differentiate pityriasis rosea (herald plaque + daughter lesions in a Christmas-tree distribution) from tinea corporis, secondary syphilis, guttate psoriasis, and similar diseases.
map.玫瑰糠疹诊断：统计 10 项临床特征（母斑、圣诞树样分布、领圈样脱屑等）满足数及: Pityriasis rosea diagnosis: count the number of satisfied features among 10 clinical features (herald plaque, Christmas-tree distribution, collarette scale, etc.) and core features; ≥8 with ≥3 core = highly consistent, ≥5 with ≥2 core = fairly consistent, otherwise differentiate from tinea corporis / secondary syphilis / guttate psoriasis.
map.先出现单个较大「母斑」（2-10cm椭圆形橙粉色斑）: A single larger 'herald plaque' appears first (2-10 cm oval orange-pink patch)
map.数日后躯干/近端四肢出现较多「子斑」（较小椭圆斑）: Days later, numerous smaller 'daughter lesions' appear on the trunk/proximal limbs
map.皮疹长轴沿皮纹/Langer线走行（背部呈「圣诞树」样）: Lesion long axes follow skin lines / Langer lines (a 'Christmas tree' pattern on the back)
map.边缘领圈样细薄脱屑（collarette scale）: Collarette fine scaling at the edges (collarette scale)
map.主要分布于躯干及四肢近端，面部及远端少见: Mainly on trunk and proximal limbs; face and distal sites rare
map.无掌跖受累、无黏膜损害: No palmoplantar involvement, no mucosal lesions
map.近期无新药使用史（排除药疹）: No recent new drug use (rule out drug eruption)
map.真菌镜检阴性（排除体癣）: Negative fungal microscopy (rule out tinea corporis)
map.常见鉴别诊断要点: Key points for common differential diagnoses
map.环形红斑、边缘活动脱屑、中央消退；真菌镜检阳性；无圣诞树分布。KOH镜检可确诊。: Annular erythema with active scaling at the border and central clearing; positive fungal microscopy; no Christmas-tree distribution. KOH microscopy confirms.
map.掌跖铜红色斑丘疹、全身淋巴结肿大、可有黏膜斑；有性接触/硬下疳史；梅毒血清学阳性: Coppery-red papules on palms/soles, generalized lymphadenopathy, possible mucosal patches; history of sexual contact / chancre; positive syphilis serology (RPR/TPPA).
map.滴状红色丘疹/斑块，覆银白色鳞屑；刮除见点状出血(Auspitz征)；常链球菌感: Drop-like red papules/plaques with silvery scales; pinpoint bleeding on scraping (Auspitz sign); often triggered by streptococcal infection.
map.钱币状红斑、渗出结痂、瘙痒剧烈；多见四肢伸侧；无领圈样脱屑及圣诞树分布。: Coin-shaped erythema, oozing and crusting, intense itching; common on extensor limbs; no collarette scaling or Christmas-tree distribution.
map.有用药史，皮疹多形，可有黏膜累及；停药后渐退。需详细用药史排查。: History of drug use, polymorphic rash, possible mucosal involvement; gradually resolves after stopping the drug. A detailed drug history is needed.
map.玫瑰糠疹多为自限性，以对症止痒为主。若掌跖受累、全身症状明显或有高危性行为，务必: Pityriasis rosea is mostly self-limiting, managed with symptomatic antipruritic care. If palms/soles are involved, systemic symptoms are marked, or high-risk sexual behavior exists, syphilis must be ruled out. Atypical or persistent cases should see a dermatologist.

map.母斑识别：录入先发的单个椭圆形红斑（母斑）及随后躯干/四肢屈侧「圣诞树」走向的子: Herald-plaque recognition: enter the first single oval erythematous plaque (herald plaque) and the subsequent daughter lesions along a 'Christmas-tree' orientation on the trunk/limb flexures; the tool flags the typical pityriasis rosea pattern.
map.鉴别提示：对不典型分布（如仅面部、反向、环状）标注需排除梅毒、体癣、银屑病或药疹: Differentiation cue: for atypical distributions (face-only, inverse, annular) mark the need to rule out syphilis, tinea, psoriasis, or drug eruption, and advise consultation.
map.病程教育：提示本病多自限（6–8 周），给出止痒与避免过热洗澡的护理要点，减少误: Course education: note the disease is mostly self-limiting (6-8 weeks) and give antipruritic and avoid-overly-hot-baths care points to reduce misuse of potent drugs.
map.示例：胸背先现一母斑、1–2 周后躯干出现沿皮纹排列的卵形子斑 → 工具判为「典: Example: a herald plaque first appears on chest/back, then 1-2 weeks later oval daughter lesions align along skin lines on the trunk → the tool judges 'typical pityriasis rosea pattern' and advises observing self-limitation with symptomatic antipruritic care.
map.多自限，以止痒、保湿、避免热水烫洗为主；广泛或剧痒者可遵医嘱用抗组胺或光疗，不必: Mostly self-limiting, managed with antipruritics, moisturizing, and avoiding hot baths; widespread or intensely itchy cases may use antihistamines or phototherapy per physician advice, without overmedication.
